badge_hint: You have unsubmitted changes to this. Submit them, or discard the draft.
badge_hint_static: Changed in this browser only. Propose it on {{forge}} to share it, or discard the changes.

discard.title: Discard this draft?
discard.description: Your unsubmitted changes to "{{name}}" will be lost.

unsaved.title: Discard unsaved changes?
unsaved.description: You are editing and have changes that are not saved yet. Leaving now loses them.

submit.title: Submit changes
submit.mode_proposal_hint: Opens a pull / merge request for the maintainers to review.
submit.mode_commit_hint: Writes the change onto the content branch right away (maintainers).
submit.no_permission: Your account cannot submit this kind of change.
submit.done_proposal: Your proposal is open. The maintainers will review it.
submit.done_commit: Your change is committed to the dictionary.
submit.allocated_id: The new concept set got id {{id}}.

error.pull_required: The content repository moved on: it must be pulled before committing.
error.conflict: The submission conflicts with the repository.
error.forbidden: Your account is not allowed to submit this.
error.not_found: This draft no longer exists (already submitted or discarded?).
error.unauthenticated: Your session expired: log in again.
error.unreachable: The server could not be reached.
error.server: The server could not submit the change.

propose.step_create: This file **does not exist in the repository yet**, so it will be **created**.
propose.step_create_prefilled: {{forge}} opens a new-file page with the file name and the JSON **already filled in**.
propose.step_too_large: The JSON is too large to prefill, so it will be **copied to your clipboard** instead.
propose.step_create_paste: {{forge}} opens a new-file page with the file name filled in: **paste** the JSON into the editor.
propose.step_update: This file **already exists in the repository**, so it will be **updated**.
propose.step_copied: The JSON will be **copied to your clipboard**.
propose.step_open_existing: {{forge}} opens the **existing file** in its editor.
propose.step_replace_all: **Select all (Ctrl+A / Cmd+A)** in the editor and paste to **replace the whole file**: do not append, or the JSON will be invalid.
propose.step_commit: Scroll down, **commit to a new branch**, and open the pull request.
propose.step_commit_branch: Then **commit to a new branch** and open the pull request.
propose.manual_description: The clipboard is not available here: copy this content of {{path}} yourself (it is selected).
propose.popup_blocked: Your browser blocked the new tab. Allow pop-ups for this site and try again.
propose.review_intro: Your review is saved **inside this concept set's file**, so proposing it means updating that file.

profile.title: Your name
profile.description: Stored in this browser only, and written into what you create, version and review.
